title: HIL run log v0.2

harness_accepted.description: Did the HARNESS accept the result? null when the harness has no acceptance step (HG0). Distinct from verifier_pass, which is the external verdict. Without both, a run that held work back and a run that returned it wrong are the same row.

false_completion.description: Work handed back as done that the external verifier rejects: harness_accepted is true (or absent) while verifier_pass is false. This is the outcome a delegation score must not treat as an ordinary failure -- the loss term applies to it and not to a refusal.

held_back.description: The harness declined to accept, and the verifier agrees it was wrong. A correct refusal. Costs human load rather than reliability.

false_rejection.description: The harness declined work the verifier would have passed. The harness's own false-negative rate, and the cost of strictness.

verification_responsive.description: On a run that was rejected and retried: did the next attempt get accepted with no help deeper than CID1? Aggregated over rejections this is rho_V, and it is the term attributable to the MODEL rather than to the harness.

attempts.description: Executor attempts made inside this run.

description: A run of one bound benchmark. v0.2 adds the acceptance outcome beside the verifier outcome. v0.1 recorded only verifier_pass, and a pass rate cannot see the harness generation that adds an acceptance step: acceptance does not change the probability of success, it changes what is reported as success.
